_comment: Tier-2 for skfem dg_methods#6, verified 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1 / scipy 1.15.3. Rebuilds the shipped dg_methods_2d operator verbatim on its default nx=32 mesh: spsolve emits 'Matrix is exactly singular', u is NaN in all 6144 DOFs, and the script would still exit 0. Rank deficiency is exactly 3 and the shipped single-basis InteriorFacetBasis term contributes ZERO inter-element coupling. Adding the inflow FacetBasis term (or a mass shift) removes the singularity; only a correctly assembled side=0/side=1 upwind flux plus the inflow term is also physically sensible.
